input: Rarely have I encountered so perspicacious a memorandum that nonetheless contrives to obfuscate its central desideratum. In light of the auditors’ misgivings, the chair insisted that the proposal be revised before it was put forward; were the board to gloss over the recalcitrant data, any consensus would be a far cry from genuine accord. It was not until the deputy took issue with the magniloquent preamble that the committee began to zero in on the equivocations embedded in the appendix. By virtue of its circumlocutory phrasing, the report pays lip service to transparency while casting doubt on its own conclusions. Had the authors come to terms with these contradictions, they might have avoided the obdurate resistance that ensued. What ultimately undermined the initiative was not paucity of evidence but the sycophantic deference with which its advocates parried every objection.
